messages:
darya: Quick note from this morning's canary: v4.1-quant showed a borderline MRR drop on the 'multi-doc-merge' slice (n=2200). p=0.044, delta=-0.023.
omar: saw it. our current quorum fallback rule is binary: if any critical slice p<0.05 && delta < configured => autofallback. that seems brittle for medium-N slices.
kevin: agreed. propose we move to a quorum-based rollback gate: require >=2 independent slices fail OR single-slice with p<0.01. avoids edge-case single-slice blips.
darya: we also have correlated slices (multi-doc-merge and long-doc). duplicates could make quorum trigger too easily. need to de-correlate.
eval-bot: eval summary: slice=multi-doc-merge; n=2197; delta_mrr=-0.0232; p_mrr=0.044; ci=[-0.038,-0.008]; notes=high overlap with long-docs slice (approx 42% shared prompts). Link: https://console.redwood/testing/runs/2026-01-12/1723658700
omar: idea: quorum gate should count "independent signals" not raw slices. define independence by Jaccard overlap < 0.25 or by orthogonal metric failure. if overlap>0.25, treat as one signal.
kevin: nice. so quorum=2 independent signals OR single-signal with p<0.01 OR economics-exception path. also add min_unique_examples per independent-signal = 600.
darya: economics-exception?
kevin: if the variant gives >20% latency improvement & >20% cost/token improvement, then instead of autofallback we trigger "quarantine": hold promotions, run seeded replicate of 3h, and require manual signoff if replicate confirms.
omar: plus retain hard-autofallback if composite severity > 0.05 MRR across full traffic or if secondary metric (EM/F1) fails worse than -0.03.
darya: sounds good. can we add a short cool-down so multiple rapid preflight runs don't keep tripping the gate? maybe exponential backoff on autofallback actions per model version.
kevin: add backoff: first fail -> replicate_then_manual; second fail within 48h -> hard_autofallback; third fail -> automatic pin/rollback. probably reasonable.
eval-bot: historical note: single-slice p in 0.01-0.05 triggered autofallback in 142 runs; applying quorum rule (2 independent signals) would have prevented 19 of those while still catching 120 of reproducible regressions.
darya: config sketch (informal):
```
quorum_gate:
  min_independent_signals: 2
  independence_jaccard_thresh: 0.25
  min_unique_per_signal: 600
  single_signal_strict_p: 0.01
  econ_exception: {latency_pct:20, cost_pct:20, action: replicate_then_manual, replicate_hours:3}
  secondary_metric_hard_block: {metric_list:["exact","f1"], thresh:-0.03}
  backoff: {first:"replicate_then_manual", second:"hard_autofallback", window_hours:48}
```

omar: we should add an audit field in rollout-config so every quorum decision records which slices counted as independent and the Jaccard scores. for compliance and debugging.
darya: agree. ops team also asked for a simple CLI to re-evaluate a run with alternative quorum params for quick triage.
kevin: I'll open the PR that implements the quorum gate and adds the audit logs + CLI hook. will include the eval link and repro instructions.
release-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/rollout-config/pull/459 ; will page release lead if replicate confirms.
darya: action items: kevin PR + add dedupe + compute overlaps in preflight sampler; omar to add replicate job template; run replicate tomorrow 02:00 UTC with seed.
omar: scheduling replicate now. tag=replica-1723658700-01.
darya: thanks all. this quorum approach should reduce noisy autofallbacks but keep safety. :thumbsup:
